description: A DeepSeek-V3 call whose fenced arguments end mid-string at the end of output under a stop, read with every built-in dialect allowed. DeepSeek-V3.1 can also read the section (`function` as a tool name, the rest as guessed JSON), but `function` names no declared tool while the DeepSeek-V3 reading names `read_file`, so the DeepSeek-V3 reading is selected (cost::UNDECLARED_NAME). The string and object are closed (json.syntax.unterminated-string, json.syntax.close-container), the closing fence is read as inserted (tool_call.markup.missing-token) and the closers inserted at the end (tool_call.markup.missing-closers-at-end). A value completed only by end-of-output repairs inside unterminated markup is Unresolved (Malformed), as for every dialect with closers: the call is reported, never run.

calls.outcome: unresolved: malformed: malformed call: the arguments value is incomplete at the end of output
